construct: uniform flex-wrap: wrap on a flex row narrow enough to wrap
why: LayoutSchema.wrap is a first-class v15/S4 fact with a real lowering on both halves (css.ts writes flex-wrap: wrap; emit-figma-script writes native layoutWrap 'WRAP'), and LAYOUT_CHANNEL_TO_FIELD had NO entry for the channel at all — so the fact could only ever arrive from a hand-authored static contract and never from a captured library (carbon.inlinenotification's text wrapper, mui.autocomplete / badge / breadcrumbs / snackbar).

canvas.note: native layoutWrap 'WRAP' on the auto-layout frame
